explanation: Work on Pisa's bell tower began in 1173, and it started to lean during construction. Machu Picchu rose in the Andes in the 15th century, more than 200 years later.

claims.text: Construction of the Leaning Tower of Pisa began in 1173.
Machu Picchu was built in the 15th century.
The Leaning Tower of Pisa is the bell tower of Pisa Cathedral.
The Leaning Tower of Pisa began to lean while it was still under construction.
Machu Picchu was begun more than 200 years after the Leaning Tower of Pisa.

writerNotes: Self-check (§9.3). Lint: clean under content:check for writer w-part01w. Rival test: argued for Machu Picchu: Inca ruins look ancient beside a famous Italian tower; but Machu Picchu dates from the 1400s, so b takes the conservative value 1400 and the gap is still 227 years. Volatility: evergreen; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: a European and a South American landmark. Style: Oxford spelling, straight quotes, no en or em dashes, explanation within 35 words. Myths: screened against myths.json, no hit. Mystery: not applicable to a practice item. Encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: c2 is written as a century because radiocarbon work has pushed Machu Picchu's start earlier than the old 1450 date; every published estimate stays inside the 15th century.
